title: Art bible / direction and reference index
summary: 1970s corporate interiors with medieval fantasy accents, combining semi-realism and stylization. Browse current Unreal environments, 88 rendered materials, assets and the provisional fantasy NPCs. The Mascot tab contains the twelve approved poses. [Capture notes and evidence](REFERENCE_LIBRARY.md).

items.title: The company and the janitor
items.body: **Owner-confirmed setting.** A janitor works in a pharmaceutical company, cleaning the consequences of clandestine experiments and facing transformed employees. Characters records the fantasy species represented by the provisional coworker and future-enemy sprites. [NPC reference](NPC_REFERENCE.md).

items.title: 1970s corporate interiors + medieval fantasy
items.body: **Owner direction.** Predominantly 1970s corporate interiors, with medieval fantasy accents; a blend of semi-realism and stylization. No numerical style ratio or new palette is approved by this reset.

items.title: Public polish / neglected service spaces
items.body: Public spaces are clean, polished and professional. Hidden service areas are neglected and can feel dungeon-like. The Environments tab records the current Unreal baseline; unfinished map areas are not approved final direction.

items.title: Existing Unreal materials first
items.body: Use `/Game/Art/MI/Utility_Materials` for asset material decisions. Reuse tileables, trims and the current atlas system before proposing missing surfaces. Final production-reference images must come from Unreal; source albedos and generated concepts are not equivalent evidence.

items.title: Density and intentional tileable exceptions
items.body: The owner confirmed 256/512 px/m as normal references. Some floors and ceilings intentionally differ to align tileables. Preserve those UV scales and material tiling. The new material rig uses explicit 1 m / 2 m comparison shapes without changing production UVs.

items.title: Wizard mascot
items.body: Open **Mascot** for the thirteen four-digit poses, including the Stop signal, in black and white SVGs and transparent PNGs. [Current SVGs](sources/mascot-signage-revision.zip) · [Stage 4 archive](MASCOT_STAGE4_LIBRARY.md).

items.title: Approved signage
items.body: Open **Signage & UI** for the ten Basement signs, Wet Floor and A Clean Start. [Current SVGs](sources/mascot-signage-revision.zip) · [Safety-yellow palette](MASCOT_SIGNAGE_REVISION.md) · [Original artwork](BASEMENT_SIGNAGE_STAGE5.md).

items.title: Building concepts / Basement and Level_01
items.body: Study the fixed wall and ceiling details in **Building concepts**. The native captures show the current blockout and the paired paintovers propose repeatable finishes and additions for the existing Modular Blocks. [Concept notes](BUILDING_STRUCTURE_CONCEPTS_STAGE6.md).

items.title: Basement assets / Individual concepts
items.body: The selected service corridor and service counter have individual component sheets with current Unreal material references. The signage atlas proposal includes all twelve approved graphics and the legacy UV audit. [Asset brief](BASEMENT_ASSETS_STAGE7.md) · [Signage atlas](SIGNAGE_ATLAS_STAGE7.md).

items.title: Library categories and review status
items.body: Use Environments for the native map baseline, Materials for all 88 Utility_Materials instances, Assets for native mesh previews and Characters for the provisional NPC species. The Unreal references name their exact package or map. Building concepts records proposals against current native views.
